bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls enabling regulated insurers to adopt analytics and ML capabilities within compliant boundaries.
Established a shared-responsibility operating model framing that clarified insurer-owned controls versus AWS-managed controls for safe cloud adoption.
Led AWS modernization execution for monolithic policy administration and core insurance platform workloads.
